title: Desktop entry filename displayed instead of the actual program name
line: App launchers on a desktop that uses a custom folder now show the app's name instead of their .desktop file name.
explanation: Launcher names come from the desktop:/ KIO worker, which reads the Name key of .desktop files; Folder View also only parsed .desktop files when its location was exactly desktop:/. A desktop pointed at any other folder (for example a per-activity folder) therefore labelled launchers with their file name. The desktop containment now always parses .desktop files, and the folder model reads their Name for local files, so labels and the rename field show the app name; renaming such a launcher changes its Name, as desktop:/ does, instead of renaming the file.

commits.message:
containments/desktop: show app names for launchers in custom folders

Launchers were only labelled with their Name when the desktop showed the
Desktop folder through desktop:/, so any other location showed the file
name. Now the desktop parses them in every location, like on desktop:/.

BUG: 511746
